schema.defect: one sentence: what the LABEL said
schema.operation: one sentence: what the OPERATION actually did
schema.bin: INTERVENTION | CONTROL | STATISTIC | SCOPE | PROVENANCE | UNCLASSIFIED
schema.commit: SHA in this repository, must be an ancestor of HEAD
schema.round: which round it was found in or about

note: Bins were fixed in DEFECT_TAXONOMY_PREREGISTRATION.md before any row was written. UNCLASSIFIED is not a dumping ground; it is the pre-registered test of whether the bin set carves anything. THRESHOLD DEFECT, found by the gate firing at n=30: the pre-registered W_C condition is an ABSOLUTE count (a bin >= 8), not a proportion. At n=22 that was 36% of the ledger; at n=30 a bin of 9 is 30% and the same threshold fires. An absolute threshold on a growing ledger makes ONE-JOINT-DOMINATES inevitable. It is NOT changed here -- choosing a threshold after seeing which verdict it produces is the one move this file exists to refuse. The verdict is reported as pre-registered, with the defect stated beside it.

defects.defect: the pre-registration 'fixed the estimator'
defects.operation: it fixed the gate and the target and left the predictor set a class; 60 of 324 admissible estimators return the opposite verdict

defects.defect: leave-one-model-out fold errors 2.2 / 5.0 / 10.5 / 18.7 / 155.9x
defects.operation: quoted from a commit message; the analysis was never saved as a script and no reconstruction over 324 feature sets exceeds 15.6x

defects.defect: 'the floor widens 2.4-5.2x while the effect changes 0.90-1.94x'
defects.operation: neither range reproduces under any floor definition; both quoted from a commit message

defects.defect: the main results table's column is 'effect / floor'
defects.operation: two rows are |eff|/sd, two are |eff|/(p10-p90), two are neither -- three quantities under one column heading

defects.defect: Amendment 2's -18% raw sd / +11% floor
defects.operation: the original-vocabulary run was not checked into the repository, so nothing here could produce them

defects.defect: the sd column read 0.029 for qwen2.5-3b and 0.091 for llama-3.1-8b
defects.operation: true values 0.028 and 0.090; the first appears copied from the row above it

defects.defect: the table showed a null median and IQR per model
defects.operation: those result files predate the runner's percentile keys; the table rendered values the JSON did not contain

defects.defect: '2 sd of a random single head is 0.442 margin units' -- the floor the whole 'seven of eight' claim is measured against
defects.operation: no generator emitted it, and its provenance (the ORIGINAL room vocabulary, not the shipped one) was invisible

defects.defect: ratio_k1 = band floor / sham floor is the pre-registered statistic
defects.operation: the sham arm sits in early layers where an on-distribution write is near-identity; its sd collapses 547x and the ratio divides by it, reporting up to 2133x

defects.defect: mean- and resample-ablation are GENTLER interventions than zeroing
defects.operation: they displace the residual stream by 14-27% of what zeroing does -- three magnitudes, not three kinds

defects.defect: 'randdir separates D from M, the arm R6 did not have'
defects.operation: D and M have IDENTICAL prediction rows; randdir separates {D,M} from S and does nothing between D and M

defects.defect: world F ('being off the manifold matters') predicts constant_only ~ mean
defects.operation: mean writes mu, ON the manifold; constant_only writes off it. The row was derived from the world's NAME and from a label carried over from R7

defects.defect: pc_clears_own_floor means the positive control is live
defects.operation: |PC| > band sd -- magnitude only. randdir's control is sign-INVERTED on 7 of 7 cells across two rounds and passed every time

defects.defect: this repository detects wrong-signed positive controls -- detectors/control_fitness.py
defects.operation: zero callers outside its own file; the detector was dead code while the defect it was written for ran in the data

defects.defect: 'which component you ablate explains 2.7-12.3x more VARIANCE'
defects.operation: the statistic is a ratio of standard deviations; the variance ratio is the square, 7.5-151x

defects.defect: 'R6 and R7 stopped because the mean arm's positive control failed'
defects.operation: true of phi, false of internlm2, which was dropped by the ZERO arm's ratio_k1 = 0.98 -- two exclusion reasons collapsed into one, sixty lines after the same file stated both correctly

defects.defect: internlm2 is 'EXCLUDED by its own sham control' -- the instrument failed there
defects.operation: its zero-arm positive control is 4.69 band sd, second strongest of four. ratio_k1 = 0.98 says early and late heads damage alike, a fact about the model, not a failed control

defects.defect: headline.py printed '-> DIRECTION-MATTERS' as R7's gate result
defects.operation: the pre-registered stopping rule returns NOT MET below 3 included-and-valid cells; the gate code never implemented it and evaluated the bands on 2, contradicting the shipped README

defects.defect: the sham arm controls for THAT you ablated a head
defects.operation: band is the upper half and sham is the early layers, so it controls for that AND for where in the stack; eight rounds inherited the confound

defects.defect: the arms' displacement is matched to 0.00%
defects.operation: matched in HEAD COORDINATES, a basis the model does not privilege; the model sees W_O.delta. Measured afterwards at 1.11x spread against 5.8x permitted, so the label survived -- but not by construction

defects.defect: 'make verify needs no GPU, no network and no dependencies'
defects.operation: it died with ModuleNotFoundError on a fresh clone under the system interpreter; every prior test had been handed the project venv on the command line

defects.defect: detector 6 checks whether a prose number has a generator
defects.operation: its number regex was blind to every ratio in the repository (the 'x' suffix), then to a trailing period, then accepted any prose number whose OWN rounding appeared in the reference set -- 57.9% false-pass on the shape of nearly every number here

defects.defect: 'measure two set sizes and the curve is fixed', 12/12 within 2x
defects.operation: the trivial predictor that ignores k scores 9/12, so the margin is against a floor of 9 and not 0; and of the ten possible pairs the narrowest high-k pair scores 6/12 -- the rule needs two WIDE points, one of them small

defects.defect: 'random component choice accounts for 10% of the measured quantity'
defects.operation: the measured quantity itself sits 10x above any behavioural change: at k=1 the floor is 9.9% and the largest effect 10.4% of the distance to a flipped answer, so the whole comparison is sub-behavioural

defects.defect: 'each detector refuses rather than degrading'
defects.operation: attacked with six inputs derived from their own assumptions, three of five returned a CLEAN verdict on garbage -- including scale=0, which reopened the exact hole the scale argument was made required to close

defects.defect: 'make verify catches any number that drifts from its data'
defects.operation: Detector 6 exempted code fences by design; 184 of 476 README numbers lived there, 54% of the front page. It caught 61%. Removing the exemption surfaced a mistyped digit that had been invisible since it was written

defects.defect: 'every number here traces to a checked-in result file'
defects.operation: true -- and 40 result files traced to nothing. No runner stamped its source; git timestamps show 11 results predate their runner's current code

defects.defect: a job labelled `hook-identity-internlm2-gpu`, submitted to the GPU queue to escape a CPU-only NaN
defects.operation: hook_identity.py hardcoded device_map='cpu'. It ran on the CPU and returned the same NaN, which I read as confirmation rather than as the same run repeated. The label disagreed with the code one level ABOVE the code

defects.defect: hook_identity reported *** HOOK IS MISLABELLED *** on internlm2
defects.operation: all 16 heads returned NaN because the model's vendored CPU path produces an all-NaN forward. NaN is not a large error, it is no measurement. UNVERIFIED folded into OVERTURNED, by a detector on its second invocation

defects.defect: validate_provenance's IMPOSSIBLE verdict
defects.operation: `not older` collapsed False and None, so a file whose git timestamps were simply unknown was convicted; and the producer was INFERRED FROM THE DIRECTORY, so hook_identity's results were compared against R1's runner. Location is a label; the producer is the object

defects.defect: R7's headline ordering `mean < randdir < shrink` in 4 of 4 cells
defects.operation: randdir's positive control is sign-INVERTED on 4 of 4 models, so its readability was |PC|/sd of a control pointing the wrong way. Retracted to `mean < shrink` on 3 of 3 admissible cells

defects.defect: the front page's first sentence: 'almost none report what a random component of the same size does' -- the project's entire novelty premise
defects.operation: FALSE. One arXiv query returned ten of ten relevant papers reporting a random-component control, several as required methodology, including one that samples the null across TEN SEEDS per cell. The query contained the word 'random' so the sample cannot estimate a base rate -- but it refutes a universal negative, which is what the sentence was

defects.defect: two of the eight published effects -- L16H3 and L19H0 -- are among the thirty random draws that define the floor judging them, and L16H3 is that sample's extreme value
defects.operation: CIRCULAR, and conservative. Leaving both out SHRINKS the floor from 0.4418 to 0.4131, so L16H3 clears by MORE (1.13x vs 1.06x) and the count is unchanged. A defect whose sign happens to help the conclusion is still a defect; the control is now in make headline

defects.defect: the headline floor 0.4418 is 2*sd of THIRTY RANDOM DRAWS from a band of 168 heads, while R10 measured all 168 exhaustively in the same vocabulary at the same margin -- the reference class was never itself checked
defects.operation: UNRESOLVED, not wrong. The exhaustive floor is 0.4870 (10.2% higher) and against it the count is 8 of 8, not 7 of 8. A 30-draw floor from this population spans 2.7x between p05 and p95, so the two are the same measurement to within its own resolution. The floor had a noise floor

defects.defect: detector 6 skipped every blockquote line -- 97 of 625 numbers, 15.5%, of which 25 were emitted by no generator and 18 were on the front page
defects.operation: A BLANKET EXEMPTION WITH A SOUND PREMISE. Correction blocks do restate wrong numbers deliberately; but the rule could not name what it exempted, and this repository argues in blockquotes, so every NEW claim written in that style went unchecked too. Replaced by the per-value <!-- unbacked-ok --> marker, which forces each exempt number to be listed next to the sentence needing it

defects.defect: the front page's held-out variance decomposition -- 'on R5's six margin cells the floor carries 52%, effects spanning 3.8x and floors 5.2x'
defects.operation: WITHDRAWN, unreproducible. 28 admissible pairings of R5's checked-in fields span 4.3%-90.8% and NONE lands within 3pp of 52. Third instance after R4 and R5 of the prose fixing the claim and leaving the estimator free. The in-sample half (72.1%, 3.1717 vs 1.2298, 6 cells, 5 distinct floors) reproduces exactly and is now generated

defects.defect: detector 6's own documented invocation -- the example in its docstring -- crashed on relative_to(ROOT) for any relative path argument
defects.operation: BROKEN AND INVISIBLE. make verify passes no arguments and takes the glob branch, whose paths are already absolute, so the only broken path was the one a human would type. Fixed with .resolve()

defects.defect: 'inside the noise floor' was used for nine rounds as one predicate covering two different failures: NOT MEASURABLE (below what the instrument resolves on 120 items) and NOT DISTINCTIVE (resolvable, and a random head of the same size does the same)
defects.operation: SEPARATED, for free, from data already checked in. Every head's drop is a mean over the SAME items, so the item-sampling term appears in every layer and the quietest layer bounds it from above; R10 measured all 28. At most 0.66% of the floor's VARIANCE is item sampling. Against that bound 3 of 8 effects are MEASURABLE (11.8x, 3.4x, 3.3x) and 0 of 8 are DISTINCTIVE. The proven copy head is 3.3x above measurement noise and 0.27x of the floor -- the experiment saw it clearly, and what it saw is not special

defects.defect: detector 6 globbed only **/README.md, so every AMENDMENT_*.md, every PREREGISTRATION.md and the new top-level ADVERSARY.md were outside the checked population
defects.operation: WIDENED to **/*.md: 11 files became 27, and 16 previously invisible unbacked numbers surfaced at once -- including the WITHDRAWN R4 fold errors (155.9x) sitting unguarded in the amendment that withdraws them. Same class as the blockquote exemption removed the same day: a clean report over the wrong POPULATION reads exactly like a clean report over the right one

defects.defect: the exemption marker regex was <!--\\s*unbacked-ok:([^>]*)-->, so a single '>' anywhere inside the exemption's own prose ended the character class early and the whole marker silently did nothing
defects.operation: TRIGGERED BY ITS FIRST REAL USE: ADVERSARY.md's marker contained '>700'. No error, no sign in the report, six numbers flagged as unbacked while carrying an exemption. Fixed to a non-greedy match to '-->'. One character disabling a mechanism is the same shape as the unclosed code fence this detector already refuses on

defects.defect: the detector's own false-pass rate is a function of how many numbers the repository generates, and nothing was measuring it over time
defects.operation: MEASURED AND WATCHED. 17.2% at a reference set of ~500 became 24.34% at >700 in one session -- a 41% relative increase in false passes, caused entirely by adding generators to strengthen the gate. Now printed on EVERY make verify run with a ceiling that fails the build. The ceiling was chosen knowing the current value, so it is stated as NOT a pre-registration

defects.defect: an exemption written in scientific notation (3.55e-05) registers as 3.55 and 05, because the number pattern does not parse exponents -- so it exempts neither value
defects.operation: FIXED by writing the exemption in the table's own decimal notation. The match rule is not the concept, in the mechanism built to enforce that numbers match their concept

defects.defect: the front page led with 'all eight published single-head effects sit inside the noise floor', when 5 of the 8 were read-head CANDIDATES whose set sits at the 46.7th percentile of the null -- there was nothing there to find -- and only 1 (L22H7) was an independently established mechanism
defects.operation: REWRITTEN to lead with the one established mechanism. Predicted by ADVERSARY.md as row A1 BEFORE it was made, and acted on the same day, which means the row can no longer be scored by a real adversary. Recorded as unscoreable rather than quietly dropped

defects.defect: the page led with the provocative reading ('published effects are noise') of data whose honest reading is 'the single head is the wrong unit' -- the k=5 COPY circuit result, 0.0th percentile at -1.4279 against a 4.477 margin, was in the same round the whole time
defects.operation: REWRITTEN. The circuit result now sits beside the single-head number instead of three screens below it. ADVERSARY.md row A3, self-corrected, unscoreable, and recorded as such

defects.defect: both REFUSED branches of the exhaustive runner called Path('results').mkdir -- CWD-relative -- while writing to --out's full path, so a refusal into a not-yet-existing directory raises FileNotFoundError and writes NOTHING
defects.operation: FIXED before the phi-3.5-mini job could hit it (phi has refused before, on n=0 items). The fossil was on disk: an empty untracked results/ in the repo root, created 03:02 by task 41 -- the R9 run that died on its last line with exactly this error. The one branch whose purpose is to leave an honest record of 'this model could not be measured' was the one that could leave nothing but a traceback in a job log

defects.defect: the NEW front-page lead, written one step earlier to fix an overstatement, said the k=5 COPY circuit is at the '0.0th percentile of the null' and added 'Not marginal. Not inside anything.'
defects.operation: OVERSTATED. A percentile from 30 draws resolves to 3.3%: '0.0th' means 'below all thirty' and nothing finer, and the circuit is beyond the most extreme of them by 0.38 sd. On the statistic k=1 already uses -- |effect|/(2*sd of its own null) -- it is 1.45x, i.e. it clears by 45%, not by an order of magnitude. The claim survives, the sentence did not. Both units now reported on one statistic: L22H7 at k=1 is 0.27x, COPY at k=5 is 1.45x, and the k=5 floor is 2.02x larger

defects.defect: the front page's SECOND lead -- 'the single head is the wrong unit' -- written one step earlier to replace an oversold first lead
defects.operation: ALSO WRONG, and wrong in the direction that flattered the project. Ablating all 168 band heads once each: 9 CLEAR the exhaustive floor at k=1, up to 2.54x. Single-head ablation resolves effects here perfectly well. What it does not do is rank the eight published heads anywhere near the top -- they sit at 10, 55, 56, 109, 113, 115, 116, 143 of 168, and the independently proven copy head is 56th. Zero of the nine clearing heads is among the eight. Third front page in three steps; all three kept and annotated

defects.defect: _PRODUCER recorded Path(__file__).name -- a BASENAME. Eleven rounds all call their script run.py, so the provenance check looked it up with a glob, took whichever candidate sorted first, and reported producer_guessed_from_path = False
defects.operation: IT CONVICTED R11's RESULT AGAINST R6's RUNNER. The earlier fix -- 'read the producer from the file, do not infer it from the directory' -- was right and incomplete: what the file recorded could not name the object either. Now a repo-relative path in all 12 runners, and a basename matching more than one file is treated as a GUESS, which cannot convict

defects.defect: the IMPOSSIBLE branch fired on a result whose stamp matched no CURRENT runner and whose runner had not been committed since -- concluding the stamp could not have come from that runner
defects.operation: FALSE CONVICTION, on exactly the scenario the stamp exists to reveal: a 16-minute job holds the source it loaded, so editing and committing the runner mid-run leaves the result carrying the PRE-EDIT hash while git reports no movement. Stamps are now resolved against every committed version of the runner, not just HEAD; a stamp found in history is reported as STALE with the reason, and cannot be called impossible

defects.defect: the front page inferred '9 of 168 heads clear the exhaustive floor, SO single-head ablation resolves effects here perfectly well' -- written one step earlier
defects.operation: THE COUNT ESTABLISHES NOTHING. Beyond 2*sd a normal over 168 numbers gives 7.6 and a Laplace gives 9.9; observed 9. Excess kurtosis is +7.43, so 2*sd is a normal-theory cut on a distribution nothing like normal, and the tail is what such a distribution hands you for free. Leave-one-out (each head judged by a null excluding it) leaves the count at 9, so the circularity check ran and came back clean -- it is the INTERPRETATION that breaks. Every statement about ORDER survives, because a ranking needs no threshold. Predicted as ADVERSARY.md row A4 at MEDIUM severity; actual severity invalidated a front-page inference, so the calibration was under-severe

defects.defect: the surviving rank claim -- 'the published heads rank 10..143 of 168' -- was computed on RAW |drop|, while R9 had already established the floor GROWS with depth, and the published heads sit at mean layer 18.1 against the top nine's 21.0
defects.operation: CONTROLLED, and the control CONFIRMED rather than killed. Ranking each head against its own layer's sd leaves the normalised top nine DEEPER still (21.8), moves the published heads by at most 21 places of 168, and puts 0 of them in the top nine either way. The stronger form is an INVARIANCE: the two top-nines share only 6 of 9 members, so WHICH heads are top is normalisation-dependent, while the published heads' absence from both is not

defects.defect: the withdrawn quiet-layer item-noise bound reported '3 of 8 measurable'
defects.operation: WRONG IN METHOD AND IN ANSWER. Measured directly against per-head SEM on the published item set: 8 of 8 are resolvable at 2 sigma, from 1.27x (L22H7) to 13.97x (L16H3). The bound did not merely rest on a bad assumption -- it also got the number wrong, in the direction that made the instrument look weaker than it is. UNVERIFIED becomes CONFIRMED by a fit instrument, not by promotion of the earlier silence

defects.defect: headline.py's load() globbed every JSON in a results directory and assumed a measurement schema, so the FIRST REFUSAL ARTIFACT crashed the whole gate with a KeyError on 'layers'
defects.operation: THE REFUSAL MECHANISM, WORKING EXACTLY AS DESIGNED, BROKE make verify FOR EVERY FUTURE CLONE. phi-3.5-mini refused correctly -- its tokenizer scores 'pine' on the fragment 'p' and 'frost' on 'fro', so the margin is not about the answer -- and the artifact landed in the right directory only because the mkdir path had been fixed an hour earlier. Refusals are now skipped in load() itself rather than in each of eleven consumers, and the count is RETURNED and PRINTED, because a silently dropped refusal is a measurement that looks like it never happened

defects.defect: the eight drop values the entire project is about had never been checked against a second implementation
defects.operation: REPRODUCE to 3.6e-06 under R10's exhaustive scan -- same items, same vocabulary, separately written runner. Float32 nondeterminism. Closure that could have failed and had never been run. The same comparison carries the method point: E132b asked about 8 heads and R10 about 336 on the same code path, 42x the questions for one 16-minute job, and asking about all of them is what produced every finding of the last five steps

defects.defect: the project's central claim is a MEASURED ZERO -- 0 of 8 distinguishable -- and no positive control for it had ever been stated, in violation of the repository's own rule that a measured zero is inadmissible until the same instrument has returned non-zero
defects.operation: IT PASSES, and the control was in the same run all along: 9 heads are BOTH resolvable at 2 sigma AND beyond the exhaustive floor, at 1.18x-2.54x the floor and 2.5x-22.1x their own SEM. Also a dynamic-range check that had never been run: for 167 of 168 heads the floor exceeds that head's own measurement noise. The exception is NAMED, not averaged away -- L26H7 has 2*SEM 0.4991 against a floor of 0.4870, so no verdict about it is possible at all

defects.defect: the distinguishability verdict uses the STUDIED BAND's own heads as the null -- a distribution of heads that DO things -- and the alternative null R1 originally used (the sham band, L0-7) had never been applied to the eight
defects.operation: PRE-REGISTERED >=4 of 8 clearing the sham floor as 'the reference class decides the verdict'; observed 3, DID NOT FIRE, so that claim is not made. But the shape is sharper: the two floors are 6.15x apart from reference class alone, and 78 of 168 band heads (46%) also clear the sham floor. Clearing it is not distinction, it is being in the second half of the network. With R9's depth result the reading is exact -- L22H7 is distinguishable from an early-layer head and indistinguishable from a late-layer one, so its ablation number carries DEPTH information, not ROLE information

defects.defect: 'clearing the sham floor is being in the second half of the network' -- written one step earlier as the interpretation of the 46% figure
defects.operation: TOO COARSE, and the direct measurement shows why. The per-layer clearing rate rises with depth (Spearman +0.645 over 28 layers) but NOT monotonically: it peaks at 83% in L16-L17 and falls back to 8% by L25, so L25 clears LESS often than L11. A hump, not a half. Two facts place the copy head exactly: L22's own rate is 42%, the band average, and within its layer L22H7 is the 5th of 5 heads that clear -- the smallest. And 4 of the 8 published heads live in the PEAK layers where 83% of heads clear, which is why they clear the sham floor and why it establishes nothing

defects.defect: the page promised a stranger can check every claim with no dependencies, and that path had not been re-tested since the gate grew from 11 files to 28 and gained a refusal artifact, two round directories and the provenance validator
defects.operation: TESTED, not asserted: fresh clone of the published remote, /usr/bin/python3 with numpy confirmed absent, every stage runs, 28 of 28 files backed, 73 numbers recomputed, attack suite 6 of 6, 2.62 s and 24 MB. It PASSES. The run also surfaced a state the page did not mention -- provenance reports 0 CONFIRMED because _PRODUCER changed in all 12 runners the same day -- now explained on the page rather than left to surprise the reader

defects.defect: the Bash tool reset the working directory to /home/ivan after a subshell cd, so every subsequent relative-path command in that step targeted a DIFFERENT repository -- a grep for the front page returned '# BroueLean'
defects.operation: NEAR MISS, and the thing that stopped it was not designed to. The edit script asserted its anchor text was present BEFORE writing, so it aborted on the wrong file instead of clobbering it; /home/ivan/README.md's mtime is still 2026-04-17. An assertion written as a correctness check on the TEXT functioned as a guard on the DIRECTORY. All subsequent file operations in this project now use absolute paths

defects.defect: the distinguishability statistic has always been |drop| > 2*sd, which silently places the null at ZERO. The studied band's null has mean +0.0479 = 0.20 sd: ablating a random late-layer head improves the correct-answer margin more often than it hurts, 100 positive vs 68 negative of 168
defects.operation: CORRECTED to |drop - mean| > 2*sd, and IT CHANGES THE HEADLINE COUNT: L16H3 goes 0.96x -> 1.06x and CLEARS, so the figure is 1 of 8, not 0 of 8. The proven copy head moves the other way, 0.27x -> 0.37x, and stays far inside. Across 168 band heads the count goes 9 -> 10. The offset was first shown NOT to be an intervention artifact: the sham band is centred (+0.0040, 0.10 sd, 51/45 signs) while the studied band is at 0.20 sd, so it grows with depth alongside the spread and is a fact about the late band rather than about zero-ablation

defects.defect: correcting the k=1 null's centring left every OTHER comparison uncentred, and one of them was the front page's OPENING LINE: '0 of those 9 are among the eight published heads'
defects.operation: THE CORRECTION OBLIGED A RE-RUN AND I HAD NOT DONE IT. Centred everywhere: the k=1 clearing set goes 9 -> 10 and the tenth is L16H3, A PUBLISHED HEAD, so the opening line's '0 of those 9' becomes '1 of those 10'. The k=5 circuit goes 1.45x -> 1.65x, and the centred ratio turns out to be exactly |z|/2 -- so 'x floor' and 'z' were two names for one quantity with one mis-centred, printed side by side. The sham-band comparison is UNCHANGED at 3 of 8 because that null's mean is +0.0040, which is the evidence the rule was applied everywhere rather than where it flattered. Uncentred forms are still emitted so each correction can be read against what it corrects

defects.defect: the task was described as a BINDING task for twelve rounds. Every runner picks the query as the first single-token person and every binding assigns all eight, so the query is always Alice; fact lines follow a fixed order, so Alice's fact is always line 0
defects.operation: THE CORRECT ANSWER IS ALWAYS THE ROOM IN THE FIRST SENTENCE. 'Copy the room from line 0' scores 100% without matching a name. The labels are balanced -- the four rooms take 23.5%-26.2% over 400 seeds -- so it is the STRUCTURE that is degenerate, not the answer key. It does not break any comparison BETWEEN heads, since all face the same task; it breaks the DESCRIPTION. L22H7 may be copying from position 0 rather than resolving a name, and no measurement here can distinguish those, because the two strategies agree on every item the task contains

defects.defect: the task audit's own import guard was `except Exception: return None`, and it swallowed a NameError (headline.py had no `import sys`) so the entire section vanished from the output with no error
defects.operation: A GUARD THAT TURNS A BUG INTO AN ABSENCE -- the exact pattern this repository keeps finding in other people's checks, hiding one of its own for a run. Narrowed to ImportError and made loud: it now refuses with a message rather than returning None, because reporting nothing looks identical to reporting no problem

defects.defect: the fixed-position degeneracy depends on the TOKENIZER -- the query is the first single-token person -- so different models could have been asked about different people at different line indices, making R1's cross-model ratio a comparison of two different tasks
defects.operation: PROBED and UNIFORM. Across 8 model x vocabulary cells the distinct query line indices are [0]: single-token counts differ (8, 8, 6, 4 of 8) but Alice is single-token under every tokenizer tested, so every model is asked about line 0. Cross-model comparisons stay commensurable. The degeneracy is not model-specific -- it is everywhere

defects.defect: the first version of this probe REIMPLEMENTED the runner's tokenization instead of reusing it, omitting the prefix_len adjustment, and reported 0 of 8 single-token persons for phi-3.5-mini
defects.operation: WRONG, and caught only because the actual run had already PRINTED 6/8 to its job log. The disagreement with a number the object had emitted is the entire reason it surfaced. Same 'match rule is not the concept' defect this repository keeps finding in other people's checks, committed while investigating that exact class. The probe now uses the runners' own convention and is checked in with a producer stamp

defects.defect: '8 of 8 resolvable at 2 sigma' was computed on the PUBLISHED item set and stated without that scope, while the disjoint item set from the same round sat unused for this check
defects.operation: IT IS 7 OF 8 ON THE DISJOINT SET. L22H7 goes 1.27x -> 0.57x and flips; every other head is stable and far above 1. The INSTRUMENT replicates -- across all 168 band heads the runs agree on 157 verdicts with Spearman +0.9825 between ratios -- so it is this one HEAD that does not. Third independent signature on the same head: rank moved 40 places between item sets while every other moved <=5, worst SEM-versus-disagreement case in the band, and the only resolvability verdict to flip

defects.defect: across two steps I let R13's task-level finding hang as an implication about the MODEL -- that L22H7 'may be copying from position 0' -- without testing it
defects.operation: REFUTED BY THE PRE-REGISTERED PROBE. Shuffling the fact lines so the answer lands at a random index: accuracy 1.000 -> 0.800 against chance 0.25, pre-registered verdict MIXED. Every line is above chance and the worst is 2.3x it. The confound control, built to separate a STEP (position-copying) from a SMOOTH DECAY (primacy), returned a THIRD shape -- a U, primacy AND recency, ends 0.966 vs middle 0.639, z=+4.96. R13's statement about what the TASK permits stands unchanged; the insinuation about what the MODEL does was mine and is dead

defects.defect: qwen2.5-1.5b's clearing profile was described as a HUMP peaking at L16-L17, and the peak location was quoted as a fact about the model rather than about a rate measured on 12 heads
defects.operation: THE PEAK DOES NOT TRANSFER AND ON THE SECOND MODEL IT IS NOT EVEN RESOLVED. qwen2.5-3b's profile has three near-equal maxima (56, 50, 50%) and a dead zone across L1-L11; with 16 heads per layer a rate carries +-24 points at 95%, so its four highest layers are statistically indistinguishable. What DOES transfer is the CENTROID: 22.833 with a bootstrap 95% CI of [21.52, 24.01], which excludes the ABSOLUTE prediction of 17.23 and contains the RELATIVE one of 22.34 -- depth fraction 0.6383 vs 0.6524. The pre-registered verdict RELATIVE fires on an interval rather than a point, which is more than it asked for; no peak-layer claim is made for the second model

defects.defect: the exhaustive runner's correctness filter would, on the SHUFFLED task, keep a population skewed 10.2 points toward the ends of the list -- exactly the positions the model handles best -- and the resulting floor would be the easy half's floor with nothing in the output saying so
defects.operation: CAUGHT BEFORE THE COMPUTE, from R14's own per-item records, in a run that has not happened. First time in this project a design was attacked before rather than after. The fix costs nothing: drop the filter, because a drop is a change in MARGIN and a margin is defined whether or not the argmax is correct -- and on the original task accuracy is 1.000, so the filter has never rejected a single item there. The separate MIN_ITEMS refusal branch, which exists for models that cannot do the task at all, is unaffected

defects.defect: the pre-registered taxonomy verdict ONE-JOINT-DOMINATES has been reported prominently since n=31, and its threshold defect (an absolute count on a growing ledger) was flagged at the time and never measured
defects.operation: DEAD AS EVIDENCE, by permutation test. With labels assigned uniformly at random over the six bins it fires on 20000 of 20000 draws at n=69. It was informative at n=22 (10.8%), mostly inevitable at n=31 (67.0%), and carries nothing from about n=45. Reported rather than deleted, because a pre-registered gate that stops discriminating is a finding about the gate. What replaces it is the DISTRIBUTION: chi-square 20.65, permutation p 0.00055, and the signal is carried by the two SMALL bins -- INTERVENTION 2 and UNCLASSIFIED 4 against an expected 11.5 -- not by the large one the threshold watches

defects.defect: the taxonomy verdict function's REACHABLE SET shrinks as the ledger grows, and nothing reported it. UNCLASSIFIED never decreases and TAXONOMY-EXISTS requires it <= 2, so that outcome became permanently unreachable at n=22; THIRTEEN-ONE-OFFS needs >= 5 but the >= 8 branch is tested first and masks it
defects.operation: THE VERDICT SPACE COLLAPSED TO ONE REACHABLE OUTCOME AT n=26, forty-four rows ago. Replaying row by row, the test discriminated five ways in its first 26 rows and has been frozen since -- it worked, and then the ledger grew past it. Sharper than the permutation test in the row before: that showed the verdict is uninformative, this shows it is the only thing the function can return. validate_defects.py now prints the reachable set on every run, because a function whose reachable set shrinks keeps printing a verdict long after it has stopped being one, and the printout is indistinguishable from a working test

defects.defect: the taxonomy power curve continued the main permutation loop's random generator, whose state depends on how many draws it consumed -- which is n -- so every added defect row silently shifted the published curve
defects.operation: CAUGHT WHEN THE GATE FLAGGED A NUMBER THAT HAD BEEN CORRECT ONE COMMIT EARLIER. A generated number that moves when UNRELATED data moves cannot be checked against anything, which is the same failure as a hand-copied one wearing a generator's clothes. Each point now uses its own seeded RNG and two consecutive runs return identical values

defects.defect: a commit message was damaged by the shell: git commit -m inside double quotes COMMAND-SUBSTITUTED a backticked field name, deleting it and leaving a hole in the sentence. make verify checks the repository's prose and never its history, so the diary -- which is the durable record for the next reader -- has no gate at all
defects.operation: AMENDED before pushing, and the mechanism recorded. The preventive is procedural and already the project's norm: every other commit used a heredoc with -F, which does not substitute. No detector was added, for the reason in D74

defects.defect: the detector written to find that damage across 86 commits flagged 58 of them, and its rule -- any run of two or more spaces -- measures TEXT ALIGNMENT, not shell damage
defects.operation: UNFIT, and the check could not find its own target case. Sampled three flagged commits: all three were aligned tables inside the body. The one odd-backtick flag was a ``` code fence. The single real instance was already amended and so was invisible to it. NO MECHANICAL SIGNATURE EXISTS -- a vanished substitution leaves nothing distinguishable from ordinary prose -- so NO DETECTOR WAS ADDED, and that is the deliverable. A loud unfit check is as dangerous as a silent one when its output is plausible: the only reason 58 damaged commits were not reported is that three of them were opened and read

defects.defect: R2's clears_2sd verdicts used |d_top| > 2*sd with the null placed at zero -- the same defect corrected in R1 -- and R2 had never been audited the way R1 has
defects.operation: CENTRED, and the verdicts SURVIVE: 4 of 5 either way. Every one of the five nulls is off-centre and all NEGATIVE, from -0.19 to -0.62 sd, further than R1's band at +0.20 and in the opposite sense -- ablating random heads HURTS induction while it HELPED the room-task margin. d_top is negative too, so centring makes clearing harder, and the count holds because the effects are 6.5x to 18.7x the floor. This also yields the sharpest available statement of why R1 and R2 disagreed: on one scale, R1's eight run 1.06 down to 0.01 and R2's valid four run 1.20 up to 18.68 -- the distributions barely touch, and the disagreement is about EFFECT SIZE, not method

defects.defect: R2's task has the same fixed-offset degeneracy R13 found in R1's, and it had never been audited. Sequences are core+core with T=64 CONSTANT, so the answer at position T+i always sits exactly T positions back -- a head attending at a constant distance solves it with no content matching
defects.operation: THE TASK CANNOT DISTINGUISH positional copying from prefix-matching, because the two agree on every sequence it contains. Ids are uniform random over 39000 so there is no LEXICAL shortcut, but the POSITIONAL one is complete. Does not break any comparison between the top-k and random-k heads -- they face the same task, so the floor, the 4-of-5 count and the effect sizes stand. Breaks calling them prefix-matching or induction heads as a claim about CONTENT. Repair is R14's shape: vary T per sequence

defects.defect: the head-SELECTION criterion is defined by the degenerate feature: induction_scores measures attention from position i to position i-T+1, a fixed offset, and its own docstring calls that a 'prefix-matching score'
defects.operation: THE NAME ASSERTS CONTENT MATCHING; THE COMPUTATION MEASURES DISTANCE. A label carried where a derivation was needed, inside the function that chooses which heads the entire round is about -- so selection and readout are degenerate in the same direction, and a constant-distance head would score maximally on both

defects.defect: the front page opened with FIVE correction blocks before stating what the project found, and the first runnable command sat 5685 words in, at line 513 of 994
defects.operation: MEASURED, not suspected. A reader forming a mental model in the 1-3 minutes the review standard calls L2 received, in order: the task is not what we said, R14 resolved something, every number is in one configuration, R12 settled the hump -- and only then the finding. The page read as a chronology of the author's corrections rather than as an inferential path, and an L2 failure caps the artifact because nobody reaches the depth where the rigour is. FIXED BY INSERTION, NOT REORDERING: the finding, the runnable command and a pointer to the six-version retraction ladder now sit above everything, and nothing was deleted or moved. The finding carries its own retraction pointer inline, so a reader who stops there still knows it was corrected six times

defects.defect: 'ablation magnitude and mechanistic role are close to unrelated on this task' -- a claim about a RELATIONSHIP between two variables, promoted to the top of the front page one step earlier, resting on exactly ONE head with an independently established role
defects.operation: n=1 ON THE ROLE AXIS. L22H7 is the only established mechanism here; five of the other seven were read-head CANDIDATES, and a candidate is a hypothesis, so finding hypotheses fail to clear a floor is close to tautological (already conceded as ADVERSARY.md row A1). One point is an anecdote, not a relationship. THE REVERSE DIRECTION IS SUPPORTED AND IS NOW WHAT THE PAGE SAYS: of the 10 heads that clear the exhaustive floor, the first published one is the 10th, and 7 of the 10 clear by HELPING the model -- that rests on 10 points and needs no second known mechanism. The asymmetry is the honest finding and is stronger than the symmetric claim it replaces

defects.defect: the prior-effects file's note -- written by me -- said the eight were 'five read-head CANDIDATES, one independently proven copy head' and two unlabelled. I had never opened the source experiment to check
defects.operation: WRONG COMPOSITION. E132b's `sel` dict has SEVEN keys and its `drop` dict has eight: seven selected read-head candidates plus L22H7, which E132 ranked FIRST on room attention and which was added externally. Self-report about a source experiment, believed for fifteen rounds because the file it lived in was mine

defects.defect: fifteen rounds treated 'the eight published effects' as a given set without asking how it was chosen -- the set is the heads ATTENTION picked, and the audit measures them with ABLATION, a two-instrument comparison that had never been run
defects.operation: THE INSTRUMENTS ANTI-CORRELATE. Over 168 band heads: Spearman(|centred ablation|, room attention) = -0.1885 and (name attention) = -0.3952. L15H7 is 168th of 168 on BOTH attention criteria and 9th by ablation. Top-5 by name attention land at ablation ranks 129, 137, 157, 88, 167. NOT A DISCOVERY -- attention as an unreliable proxy for causal importance is established background, stated as such in arXiv 2504.13752's abstract, and the literature query's positive control is reported (one relevant hit, noisy, no completeness claimed). What R16 adds is the consequence for this audit: the eight were selected by exactly the proxy known to fail, which gives 'the loudest heads were never identified' a named cause

defects.defect: R16 correlated attention with |centred ablation| only. The absolute value discards the sign, which this project had already shown matters -- 100 positive against 68 negative in the band, 7 of 9 clearing heads clearing by HELPING -- and a reader given only a negative number would fill in 'high-attention heads help when ablated'
defects.operation: IT IS A MAGNITUDE EFFECT, NOT A DIRECTION ONE. Signed Spearman is about three times weaker: room -0.0583 against -0.1885, name -0.1142 against -0.3952. Attention picks heads that do LESS, in either direction. The top name-attention quartile does carry a direction -- 9 positive against 33 negative, mean signed drop -0.0311 -- so those heads do tend to hurt when ablated, which is what a real role predicts; their effects are simply small, which is why they rank low on |ablation|. Both forms now emitted so the negative number cannot be misread

defects.defect: R12's verdict is a claim about DEPTH, measured with an instrument whose sensitivity is monotone in depth and was never controlled. Ablation zeroes the FINAL POSITION ONLY, so a head's writes at positions 0..n-2 survive; the layers that can read them number NL-1-L, which is NL-1 at layer 0 and ZERO at the last layer where the measurement is complete. (NL-1-L)/NL is a FRACTION OF DEPTH -- the exact shape of RELATIVE, R12's surviving hypothesis -- so the confound manufactures RELATIVE out of ABSOLUTE, and the two predictions were 5.6 layers apart with the later one winning
defects.operation: POSITIVE CONTROL RUN, AND IT FIRES AGAINST THE CONFOUND WITHOUT CLEARING IT. A bias-only profile -- flat truth times monotone sensitivity -- must be MAXIMAL at the last layer. qwen2.5-3b clears at 0.000 there, its global minimum, against a peak of 0.562 at L26; qwen2.5-1.5b is 0.167 against 0.833 at L16. So the bias does not run the SHAPE. It still moves the CENTROID, which is a first moment of truth times sensitivity and is pulled late whatever the truth looks like, and the control cannot separate 'sensitivity is flat' from 'the last layers do nothing'. R12's RELATIVE is therefore UNVERIFIED -- not OVERTURNED, because the shape control is real evidence, and not CONFIRMED, because the confound points exactly the way the winner points. The settling run is pre-registered on R12's page: ablate at ALL positions and see whether the centroid moves earlier by a fixed FRACTION or a fixed NUMBER of layers. Separately, 'final position only' is now stated in the front page's scope line, where it was missing: the unit measured throughout this repository is not a head but a head's write at the final position. Filed under INTERVENTION and not a new bin: the gate refused 'CONFOUND' as unregistered, which is the taxonomy doing its job -- inventing a category name mid-flight is the drift the schema exists to prevent. The defect is a property of the INTERVENTION itself, which cuts at one position

defects.defect: the exhaustive floor 0.4870 was quoted throughout this repository as a property of the model and the band. R15's pre-registered third reading -- per-answer-line floors -- shows it is a function of the task's headroom: per-line floors span 1.66x (0.3011 to 0.4997) and track the per-line baseline margin at Spearman +0.8810 over 8 lines. It was measured at baseline margin 4.477
defects.operation: SUBLINEARLY, WHICH CUTS BOTH WAYS AND BOTH ARE NOW STATED. Across lines the margin spans 7.54x while the floor spans only 1.66x, so the ABSOLUTE floor is comparatively robust -- which is what a noise floor should be if it measures head-to-head variability rather than task headroom. But floor/margin spans 5.84x (0.108 to 0.633), so `x floor` -- the unit this repository ranks its eight published heads in -- IS NOT PORTABLE ACROSS TASK CONFIGURATIONS. Separately, the pre-registered PRIMARY landed in the middle band: Spearman on |centred drop| +0.6092 against thresholds of 0.7 and 0.3 committed before the run, with the signed version at +0.7175 straddling it; both are reported and neither is claimed, because picking the statistic that clears is a narrative. The population confound was checked and cleared by measurement, not argument: R15 changed line order AND the correctness filter, but R14's A_orig=1.000 makes the filter a measured no-op on the comparison arm, and the two files share draw_seed 20260727, 120 items, 4 rooms and sham band [0,7]

defects.defect: ADVERSARY.md -- the file whose entire job is to score the author when he is wrong -- carried a factual error the ledger had already corrected, and had never been scored. Its A1 row described the eight audited heads as 'five read-head candidates, one proven copy head, two unlabelled'. R16 read the source experiment and found SEVEN selected plus one externally-known copy head; that was filed as D80 four rounds earlier AND LANDED ON THE PRIOR-EFFECTS NOTE ONLY. Separately its 'what the adversary will NOT find' bullet -- 'a hook that does not do what it claims' -- is a PROXY statement used in the wrong direction: PROPERTY = the intervention measures a head's causal contribution, PROXY = the hook zeroes exactly the intended slice, and proxy-passes does not imply property-holds. The witness is R10_exhaustive/run.py:213, the final-position-only ablation that became D83
defects.operation: SCORED, AND THE NUMBER IS BAD IN A SPECIFIC WAY. The file was written at 67 ledger rows; 17 defects have been found since, and it anticipated 1 cleanly (D79 <- A1, whose A1 row was already marked ACTED ON when the same error recurred one step later), 1 at the level of the class (D71 <- A7) and 1 partially (D76 <- A2). Fourteen are not on the page in any form. That is 5.9% clean, 17.6% counting class-level and partial -- both bounds emitted because the generosity of matching is a choice, and this repository has already been caught letting such a choice move a headline 2.2x. THE VALUE WAS NOT IN THE FORECAST: A4 was resolved by the file itself and scored the author under-severe, and A7's act of being written found the real problem. Writing predictions was productive; the predictions were mostly wrong, and only the second is a failure. Both annotations added in place rather than edited, and the file extended with A9-A13 covering R11-R18, which it did not touch -- including A12, which states before R18's files exist that I expect its kill NOT to fire

defects.defect: R18's PREREGISTRATION.md shipped in commit 6e8ddac citing R12's bootstrap CI half-width as 1.25 layers. The bootstrap gives 1.2439. The digit was computed in my head from two already-rounded endpoints (21.52, 24.01) instead of read from the object -- the FIFTH hand-rounding detector 6 has caught, after 96.20-for-96.151, 19.97-for-19.9637, 4.79-for-4.847, and 7.50/5.85 for 7.5365/5.8449 in the same session
defects.operation: THE ROOT CAUSE IS PROCESS, NOT ARITHMETIC: the pre-registration was committed and pushed WITHOUT running `make verify` on it, because a prereg feels like prose rather than a claim. It is a claim -- it carries the numbers a later verdict is judged against. The 1.0-layer THRESHOLD is untouched and was never a function of this digit; only the citation justifying it was wrong. The half-width is now emitted by r12() so the number is backed rather than recomputed by a reader from rounded endpoints. AND IT IS FILED AT ALL BECAUSE R17'S OWN RULE SAYS SO: 'a pattern caught before shipping is not a defect in the artifact' -- this one shipped, so the rule cuts against its author one step after he wrote it, which is the only evidence that the rule is not discretionary in his favour

defects.defect: R11's rank-stability check ranked heads by -abs(drop), placing the null at zero -- the SAME centring defect corrected in R1 and again in R2 (D75), a THIRD instance. The front page's rank list is CENTRED on the band mean (+0.0479), so the round that validates those ranks computed a ranking the repository does not use
defects.operation: IT MOVES THE HEADLINE. Uncentred: Spearman +0.9778, RMS displacement 10.22, largest mover L23H3 at 43 places, L22H7 56->96. CENTRED, which is what the front page reports: Spearman +0.9570, RMS 14.23, and L22H7 moves 41->160 -- 119 places, THE LARGEST MOVE OF ALL 168 HEADS. So 'the proven copy head ranks 41 of 168' DOES NOT REPLICATE on a disjoint item draw of the same task. The direction strengthens the qualitative claim (160 is further inside the floor) but 41 is not a property of the head and the front page reported it as one. Both rankings are now emitted with the centred one primary, and the front page carries the replication. Predicted as A13 in ADVERSARY.md ONE STEP before it was found

defects.defect: the depth-bias argument was labelled D8 -- 'logical from checked premises' -- and asserted that the instrument's sensitivity is MONOTONE in depth and therefore that the confound MANUFACTURES RELATIVE out of ABSOLUTE. Only two things are structural: at the last layer the missed cross-token paths are zero, and at earlier layers such paths MAY exist with NL-1-L possible readers. A COUNT OF POSSIBLE READERS IS NOT A MAGNITUDE OF MISSED INFLUENCE
defects.operation: RETRACTED TO D5. The sign, magnitude and monotonicity of the missed term were never established, and cancellation, backup heads, negative heads and interaction terms each break the inference -- single-component effects are known to be badly non-additive, with some context-dependent heads having near-zero singleton effect and acting only alongside others. The claim the page is entitled to is that RELATIVE is COMPATIBLE WITH an uncontrolled intervention-support confound that may covary with normalized depth. That keeps the verdict at UNVERIFIED, which it already was, and withdraws the mechanism claim dressed as a derivation. No number on the page changes; what the numbers are allowed to mean does. Raised by Ivan, who is not sampled from the weights that wrote it -- the first external correction this project has had

defects.defect: R18's page and the reported headline called L17H0 at rank 4 of 168 under I_all 'the result'. It is the maximum of EIGHT pre-specified heads surfaced by scanning 168, tested without any correction. Its one-head exact randomization p is 0.0296, which is 0.2367 after Bonferroni over the eight tested -- a POST-SELECTION DESCRIPTIVE TAIL, not a finding. Ivan named this exact failure mode before the run: scanning many components requires multiple-comparison correction or an explicit post-selection label
defects.operation: AND THE TEST THAT SETTLES IT HAD NEVER BEEN RUN IN THIS PROJECT. Every earlier round compared heads one at a time against a SCALAR floor whose reference class does not hold LAYER fixed. The right question is whether the PRE-SPECIFIED SET of eight is more extreme than a random set from the SAME LAYERS. T_pub = mean |tau - mu_band| over the set; the null replaces each published head with a uniform random head from its own layer, 50,000 times. I_final: T_pub 0.1154 against a null median of 0.1670, p = 0.7994. I_all: 0.3196 against 0.4004, p = 0.6782. NOT ENRICHED UNDER EITHER, AND BELOW THE NULL MEDIAN IN BOTH -- the eight are on average LESS extreme than same-layer random heads. Instrument checked before the null was believed: positive control on the actual top-8 gives p = 0.00004, and 200 random matched sets fall under 0.05 at a rate of 0.035 against a nominal 0.05. Layer matching is load-bearing: the eight sit in L16-L22 and magnitude varies strongly with depth, so an unmatched null manufactures enrichment from position alone. Both arms are heavy-tailed, excess kurtosis 7.31 and 6.67, which is why the percentile replaces 2*sd

defects.defect: the repository quotes '100 positive, 68 negative of 168' to characterise the band's sign distribution, and that split is RAW. Every verdict here uses the CENTRED statistic, and centred on the band mean +0.0479 the split is 64 above and 104 below. The qualitative reading INVERTS: raw says 'ablation hurts more often than it helps', centred says 'most heads are LESS harmful than the average head'
defects.operation: BOTH ARE TRUE OF DIFFERENT QUANTITIES AND ONLY ONE MATCHES THE ANALYSIS. Annotated in place at both sites rather than replaced, because the raw split is what the sign-matters argument was originally built on and deleting it would hide that the argument was made on a different quantity from the one the tests use. The centred counts are now emitted so either can be checked

defects.defect: the eight heads were SELECTED, causally EVALUATED and then AUDITED on the same 120 items, and nothing in this repository said so. From source: e132_read_head.py:29 uses SEEDS = range(3000,3300) for selection, e132b_read_head_causal.py:27 uses the same range for the causal evaluation, and R10_exhaustive/run.py:72 uses range(3000,3400) taking the first 120 that pass the same baseline-correct filter -- which R14 measured as rejecting nothing on this task for this model. R11's set B, range(3400,3800), is the ONLY independent item set in the entire project
defects.operation: IT CUTS BOTH WAYS AND BOTH ARE NOW STATED. The 'not enriched' null is STRENGTHENED: the eight fail to beat matched-layer random sets on the very data they were chosen on, with full home advantage. But every head-level number here except set B is computed on the selection data, which is a scope on all of it. THE SHRINKAGE TEST ON THE INDEPENDENT ITEMS: sum-ratio 0.8425 against a matched-layer null median of 1.0180, p 0.0150; mean-of-ratios 0.8257 against 1.0085, p 0.0098; MEDIAN-of-ratios 0.9919 against 1.0135, p 0.2769. Two of three fire and the median does not, so all three are reported rather than one being chosen -- L16H3 and L22H7 carry 75% of sum|c_A|, which makes the sum-ratio essentially a two-head statistic. THE SET-LEVEL WINNER'S CURSE IS NOT A SET PROPERTY: L22H7 alone retains 0.0401 of its centred effect on independent items, the lowest of all 168 band heads at the 0.0th percentile, exact one-head p 0.0118, against a band median retention of 1.02 and its own eleven layer-mates at 0.59 to 1.22. That is what the rank move 41 -> 160 was. RTM control: the eight are BELOW the matched-layer null median on set A, so regression to the mean predicts they shrink LESS than random and the observed direction runs against that prediction rather than being explained by it

defects.defect: R19's pre-registration -- the first confirmatory design in this repository, written two hours earlier -- carried THREE thresholds that were words rather than numbers. H-position asked for 'median head-wise ICC across positions HIGH' with no value, and for the published heads' position interaction to be 'NOT LARGER than matched controls' with no statistic and no cutoff. H-published asked for 'confirmatory effect direction MATCHING THE ORIGINAL CLAIM' while the eight heads' claimed directions were never enumerated anywhere. A pre-registration with a vague threshold is not pre-registered on that axis: it is a place where a verdict can be inserted after the fact, which is the one thing the file exists to prevent
defects.operation: AMENDED BEFORE THE RUN, WHICH IS THE ONLY TIME AN AMENDMENT IS LEGITIMATE -- R19 was still queued behind pueue 232 and results/ was empty. (1) ICC: median over heads of ICC(1,1) across the 8 positions >= 0.50, variance components over the 64 base instances, and the 0.50 is declared CHOSEN rather than derived. (2) Position interaction: P_h = RMS over positions of pi_h,p, set statistic = mean over the eight, null = replace each published head with a uniform random head FROM ITS OWN LAYER, 50,000 replicates; pass requires one-sided p >= 0.05, and p < 0.05 in the other tail is reported as 'the eight are MORE position-dependent', a finding rather than a failure. (3) Direction enumerated: all eight entered as read-head candidates plus one externally-known copy head, so the claimed direction for every one is HURT -- tau_h > 0 under drop = margin_base - margin_ablated -- one-sided throughout, no per-head exceptions. FOURTH, ADDED BECAUSE D91 MADE IT NECESSARY: a discovery/confirmation split of the 64 base instances, 0..31 nominate and 32..63 judge, deterministic from BUILD_SEED and needing no extra run. The eight are exempt and judged on all 64 because a prior experiment on a disjoint item family specified them; any head R19 itself surfaces is nominated on the first half and tested on the second, or reported as post-selection descriptive

defects.defect: Amendment 1 to R19's pre-registration, committed roughly twenty minutes earlier, enumerated the claimed direction for all eight heads as HURT and made the test one-sided. THREE OF THE EIGHT HAVE NEGATIVE DROPS IN THE SOURCE -- L16H3 at -0.4668 which is the largest effect of the set, L22H7 at -0.1317 which is the copy head, and L17H7 at -0.0352 -- so under drop = margin_base - margin_ablated those three HELP. A one-sided HURT test would have been aimed at the wrong tail for exactly them and would have systematically failed to detect them, which is a false null in this repository's own favour
defects.operation: REPLACED WITH TWO-SIDED FOR ALL EIGHT, before the run, with results/ still empty and R19 queued behind pueue 232. The reason is not convenience: E132b made NO PER-HEAD DIRECTIONAL CLAIM to enumerate, and taking the source's OBSERVED signs as the 'claimed direction' is circular because it is the same data the test would then run on. All eight reproduce in R10 to < 1e-4 on the same base margin 4.4768, so the sign convention is confirmed rather than assumed. Amendment 1's own last sentence said 'if a head's original claim was directionally different, this document is wrong and that is recorded rather than adjusted' -- that escape hatch is the one being used

defects.defect: E132b's own verdict field reads W-READ-REDUNDANT. The source experiment concluded that the read heads are REDUNDANT -- that individually they do not carry the effect -- and its own largest reported drop is L16H3 at 10.4% of the base margin. This repository has framed itself as pointing a measurement at PUBLISHED POSITIVE CLAIMS and finding them inside the noise. For seven of the eight there was no positive claim to deflate
defects.operation: THE AUDIT'S NULL IS CONSISTENT WITH THE SOURCE'S OWN CONCLUSION rather than a correction of it, and the framing is now stated that way. THE CORRECTION MUST NOT OVERSHOOT IN THE OTHER DIRECTION AND THAT IS STATED TOO: E132b never measured a reference distribution at all, never ran a matched-layer set randomization, never tested the all-position intervention, and never used a disjoint item set -- those four results are this repository's and are unaffected. And L22H7 is different: its copy-head status comes from E123, an independent positive claim, which is why the front page narrowed to 'one head with an independently established role' several steps ago. The corrected description of the audited set is SEVEN ATTENTION-SELECTED READ-HEAD CANDIDATES PUBLISHED UNDER A REDUNDANT VERDICT, PLUS ONE EXTERNALLY-ESTABLISHED COPY HEAD -- not 'eight published single-head effects'

defects.defect: I reported 'pueue 232 still running' in FOUR consecutive steps. The job started 12:48:50 and ENDED 13:11:37 -- it had been dead for over two hours. I read the STATUS WORD from `pueue status` and never read the End timestamp in `pueue log`. Worse, I monitored the queue with a hardcoded id grep (`^ (232|237)`), so a duplicate 3b job sitting in the same queue was invisible to every check I ran, and pueue task ids are not stable identifiers for a job I care about
defects.operation: A STATUS WORD IS NOT A STATE; THE End TIMESTAMP IS. Three fixes. (1) The queue is now read BY LABEL, not by remembered id -- `pueue status -g gpu | grep -iE 'R18-|R19-'` -- which immediately surfaced the duplicate 3b job that four id-greps had missed; the duplicate was removed. (2) The retry runs under `python3 -u`: 232's entire stdout was lost to buffering when it took SIGKILL, so the log held nothing but the weight-loading progress bar and the cause is UNVERIFIED rather than diagnosed. The most likely cause is memory -- another project's job holds 5.2 GB of the 16.3 GB card and a 3B model in float32 needs about 12.4 GB -- but that is inference from the current state, not evidence about 13:11:37, and it is recorded as such. (3) dtype stays float32 even though bfloat16 would halve the footprint, because R10's 3b run was float32 and the centroid comparison R12 turns on is only valid dtype-matched

defects.defect: the repository measured four separate floors -- across items, across intervention support, across task position, across layer band -- and never once asked the question that makes them a claim rather than a list: DOES A SCALAR FLOOR TRANSPORT? Every verdict here applies a floor measured in one configuration as though the decision rule it defines means the same thing in another
defects.operation: MEASURED, WITH A POSITIVE CONTROL THAT IS ALSO THE DISCRIMINATOR. Transport A's whole rule |x - mu_A| > floor_A into three configurations each differing in exactly one factor. Item sample only: 10/168 both ways, ratio 1.00 -- so the instrument IS stable across draws and a failure elsewhere is not sampling noise. Intervention support only: own reference says 14/168, the transported rule says 33/168, ratio 2.36. Task/answer position only: own says 12/168, transported says 6/168, ratio 0.50. THE TWO FAILURES POINT IN OPPOSITE DIRECTIONS, so a scalar floor is not merely imprecise -- its bias depends on which way the configuration moved and no safety factor fixes it. This is the one result in the repository that is about the METHOD rather than about the eight heads, and it is what survives D94's finding that seven of the eight carried no positive claim to deflate. HONEST LIMIT: the `own` column is the same 2-sigma rule on a heavy-tailed distribution, so this compares two applications of one rule rather than calibrating against a nominal alpha; one model, one band, one task family, k=1, one contrast per axis

defects.defect: the transport result committed one step earlier moved mu_A and floor_A together, so its 2.36x and 0.50x conflated two different failures with two different remedies: the CENTRE of the reference distribution not travelling, which a local re-centring fixes cheaply, and the SCALE not travelling, which means the floor is not a number that can be carried at all
defects.operation: DECOMPOSED, AND IT SHARPENS THE CLAIM RATHER THAN WEAKENING IT. Transporting the SCALE only, with a local re-centring, leaves the miscalibration almost untouched: I_all 32 against its own 14, shuffled 5 against its own 12. Transporting the CENTRE only, with the local scale, is nearly calibrated: 12 against 14 and 13 against 12. SO RE-CENTRING FIXES NOTHING AND THE LOCAL SCALE FIXES ALMOST EVERYTHING. The confound written before the test -- that mu and floor are not independent, so a centre-driven verdict could be spread wearing a location mask -- is refuted in the useful direction: the centre moves by almost exactly the same factor as the scale (1.98x against 2.01x for I_all) AND IT DOES NOT MATTER, because the centre is about 10% of the half-width (0.0946 against 0.9766) and shifting it barely moves a threshold sitting at +-floor. THE SCALE IS THE ESTIMAND, which is a sharper statement than 'a scalar floor does not transport'. World B -- centre-driven, cheap fix -- is killed

defects.defect: the transport table had three axes -- item sample, intervention support, task position -- and omitted the LAYER BAND, which carries the largest variation in the repository (6.15x) and is the only axis where the REVERSE direction is testable because both regions come from one result file. Separately, the conclusion 'the centre is about 10% of the half-width so it does not matter' was measured ON THE BAND and stated without that scope
defects.operation: THE LAYER AXIS FAILS IN BOTH DIRECTIONS. Sham L0-7 judged by the band's rule detects 0 against its own 4, ratio 0.00 -- you see nothing. Band L14-27 judged by the sham rule calls 78 against its own 10, ratio 7.80 -- 46% of the band. AND IT CORRECTS THE PRECEDING SECTION: centre-only transport there gives 8 against its own 4, because the centre SHIFT is 55.5% of the destination's scale rather than a few percent. THE UNIFYING QUANTITY IS |mu_dest - mu_src| / floor_dest: 0.1% for new items with centre-only ratio 1.00, 2.2% for shuffled with 1.08, 4.8% for I_all with 0.86, and 55.5% for the layer axis with 2.00. The centre matters exactly when its shift is large relative to the destination's scale, so 'the scale is the estimand' is itself scoped -- true on three of these four axes and false on the fourth. n=4 contrasts, and what makes four points worth stating is a MECHANISM rather than a trend: a threshold at +-f is insensitive to a shift small relative to f and stops being insensitive when it is not

defects.defect: the transport result was framed as a discovery -- 'a scalar floor does not transport' -- when transporting an ABSOLUTE cutoff gives a count that depends only on the destination's distribution, so the statement is trivially true of ANY absolute cutoff whenever the destination differs. Verified rather than argued: A's 2sd cutoff 0.4870 and A's own 5.95th-percentile cutoff 0.5147 agree on A by construction and give near-identical counts everywhere else (10/33/6 against 8/32/5). THE FAILURE IS NOT ABOUT 2*sd, and the section was written more dramatically than the arithmetic supports
defects.operation: REFRAMED TO WHAT IS ACTUALLY NON-TRIVIAL: that it transports PERFECTLY across item samples (10 against 10, ratio 1.00), which is not automatic and is what makes the other rows interpretable; the MAGNITUDES AND DIRECTIONS, 2.36x inflate and 0.50x deflate and 7.80x/0.00 on the layer axis; and the scale/centre decomposition with the |delta mu| / floor_dest predictor. AND THE META-SEPARATOR IS NOW STATED ONCE, WHICH IT NEVER HAD BEEN: 'does the floor transport' presupposes a right answer to 'how many heads are real', and there is no ground truth here. Transport a PROCEDURE instead of a NUMBER -- take the top 5.95% of the local band -- and it returns 5.95% everywhere by construction: it cannot fail and it cannot be validated. Calibration in this repository means SELF-CONSISTENCY, not correctness, and nothing on disk separates 'the floor is conditional' from 'we have no way to know what the floor should be'. What would separate them: a synthetic model with a constructed ground-truth circuit, or heads whose role is established by path patching, transduction or causal scrubbing rather than by the same magnitude statistic being audited. That experiment is not in this repository and is not scheduled
